title: lockdown
description: Quarantine on: lock screen and network isolation (only the server stays reachable). Sent by POST /api/security/lockdown and re-sent at most every 5 minutes while the heartbeat does not report the requested state (`quarantined`, `agent_health.network_isolated`).

reason.description: Reason entered in the panel, shown on the lock screen. A re-sent command carries the stored reason (cut to 300 characters) or "".
